name: Horse Magic
source:
A choice-driven visual novel centered on the evolving relationship between two college roommates, Kaiah and Iris. From their first semester, these best friends have shared joys, stresses, and future aspirations. Their days revolve around classes, late-night cram sessions, and spontaneous hangouts—until a single, inexplicable occurrence rocks Kaiah’s world and alters her path forever. What initially seems like a freak accident soon spirals into a moral labyrinth where her every decision feels weighted by potential heartbreak, hidden truths, and forbidden desire.

[Edited from [url=https://abysskoi.itch.io/horse-magic]itch.io[/url]]
